note: These greetings are original messages written for GarbaVibe. They are not scripture or traditional prayers. Traditions and day-wise forms can vary by region.

items.text: Shubh Navratri! May these nine nights bring light and happiness to you and your family.
Wishing you a Navratri filled with devotion, music and sweet moments.
May Maa Durga's blessings give you courage, calm and clarity.
Jai Mata Di! May strength and kindness guide your every step.
Good morning! May this Navratri morning begin with gratitude and a hopeful heart.
A new day, a fresh diya of hope. Have a blessed Navratri morning!
As the evening diyas glow, may your home be full of peace and togetherness.
May the lights of this evening carry away worries and bring gentle joy.
Dance, laugh, repeat! Wishing you a spectacular Garba night.
Let the dhol beat and the dandiya sticks sing. Happy Garba!
Celebrating Navratri with the people we love is the real festival. Shubh Navratri!
Dear friend, may this festival bring us more laughter and more memories.
Every day is a chance to be braver than yesterday. Have a courageous Navratri!
You carry more strength than you know. May this festival remind you of it.
Shubho Pujo! May the joy of Durga Puja fill your days with colour and warmth.
Wishing you a blessed Maha Ashtami full of devotion and peace.
May Maha Navami bring you fulfilment and gentle strength.
Happy Vijayadashami! May goodness win in every part of your life.
May the spirit of victory over negativity inspire you today and always.

forms.name: Shailaputri
forms.description: Daughter of the mountains, associated with steadiness and a strong foundation.
forms.greeting: Jai Maa Shailaputri! May you stand firm like the mountains and begin this Navratri with a strong, hopeful heart.
en: Jai Maa Shailaputri! May you stand firm like the mountains and begin this Navratri with a strong, hopeful heart.
On Day 1, may Maa Shailaputri bless your home with stability, peace and new beginnings.
hi: जय माँ शैलपुत्री! नवरात्रि का पहला दिन आपके जीवन में दृढ़ता और नई उम्मीदें लेकर आए।
माँ शैलपुत्री की कृपा से आपका घर सुख, शांति और स्थिरता से भरा रहे। शुभ नवरात्रि!

forms.name: Brahmacharini
forms.description: Associated with devotion, discipline and quiet perseverance.
forms.greeting: Jai Maa Brahmacharini! May devotion and patient effort bring you success in everything you do.
en: Jai Maa Brahmacharini! May devotion and patient effort bring you success in everything you do.
On Day 2, may Maa Brahmacharini bless you with discipline, calm and perseverance.
hi: जय माँ ब्रह्मचारिणी! आपकी भक्ति और मेहनत हर कार्य में सफलता दिलाए।
माँ ब्रह्मचारिणी आपको संयम, धैर्य और शांति का आशीर्वाद दें। शुभ नवरात्रि!

forms.name: Chandraghanta
forms.description: Shown with a crescent moon shaped like a bell, associated with courage and grace.
forms.greeting: Jai Maa Chandraghanta! May courage and grace guide you through every challenge.
en: Jai Maa Chandraghanta! May courage and grace guide you through every challenge.
On Day 3, may Maa Chandraghanta fill your life with fearlessness and gentle strength.
hi: जय माँ चंद्रघंटा! साहस और शांति आपके हर कदम पर साथ रहें।
माँ चंद्रघंटा की कृपा से आपके जीवन से भय दूर हो और आत्मविश्वास बढ़े। शुभ नवरात्रि!

forms.name: Kushmanda
forms.description: Associated with the creation of the cosmos and a warm, energising smile.
forms.greeting: Jai Maa Kushmanda! May her warm smile fill your days with energy, health and happiness.
en: Jai Maa Kushmanda! May her warm smile fill your days with energy, health and happiness.
On Day 4, may Maa Kushmanda brighten your life with positivity and fresh energy.
hi: जय माँ कूष्मांडा! आपका जीवन ऊर्जा, स्वास्थ्य और खुशियों से भरा रहे।
माँ कूष्मांडा की कृपा से आपके जीवन में नई रोशनी और सकारात्मकता आए। शुभ नवरात्रि!

forms.name: Skandamata
forms.description: Mother of Skanda (Kartikeya), associated with nurturing love.
forms.greeting: Jai Maa Skandamata! May a mother's love and care surround you and your family always.
en: Jai Maa Skandamata! May a mother's love and care surround you and your family always.
On Day 5, may Maa Skandamata bless your home with warmth, love and togetherness.
hi: जय माँ स्कंदमाता! माँ का स्नेह और आशीर्वाद सदा आपके परिवार पर बना रहे।
माँ स्कंदमाता की कृपा से आपके घर में प्रेम और अपनापन बढ़ता रहे। शुभ नवरात्रि!

forms.name: Katyayani
forms.description: The warrior form, associated with bravery against negativity.
forms.greeting: Jai Maa Katyayani! May you find the courage to overcome every obstacle on your path.
en: Jai Maa Katyayani! May you find the courage to overcome every obstacle on your path.
On Day 6, may Maa Katyayani bless you with bravery, strength and determination.
hi: जय माँ कात्यायनी! आपको हर बाधा पार करने का साहस और शक्ति मिले।
माँ कात्यायनी आपको हिम्मत, दृढ़ संकल्प और विजय का आशीर्वाद दें। शुभ नवरात्रि!

forms.name: Kalaratri
forms.description: A fierce form associated with dispelling darkness and fear.
forms.greeting: Jai Maa Kalaratri! May fear and darkness fade away, and hope light up your life.
en: Jai Maa Kalaratri! May fear and darkness fade away, and hope light up your life.
On Day 7, may Maa Kalaratri protect you and fill your heart with courage.
hi: जय माँ कालरात्रि! आपके जीवन से हर भय और अंधकार दूर हो और आशा का प्रकाश फैले।
माँ कालरात्रि की कृपा से आपको सुरक्षा और निडरता मिले। शुभ नवरात्रि!

forms.name: Mahagauri
forms.description: Radiant and serene, associated with purity and peace.
forms.greeting: Jai Maa Mahagauri! May peace, purity and calm fill your heart and home.
en: Jai Maa Mahagauri! May peace, purity and calm fill your heart and home.
On Day 8, may Maa Mahagauri bless you with serenity and a bright, joyful life.
hi: जय माँ महागौरी! आपके मन और घर में शांति, पवित्रता और सुकून बना रहे।
माँ महागौरी की कृपा से आपका जीवन उजाले और खुशियों से भरा रहे। शुभ नवरात्रि!

forms.name: Siddhidatri
forms.description: Associated with wisdom, accomplishment and fulfilment.
forms.greeting: Jai Maa Siddhidatri! May your efforts bear fruit and bring you wisdom and fulfilment.
en: Jai Maa Siddhidatri! May your efforts bear fruit and bring you wisdom and fulfilment.
On Day 9, may Maa Siddhidatri bless you with success, knowledge and lasting happiness.
hi: जय माँ सिद्धिदात्री! आपकी मेहनत सफल हो और जीवन में ज्ञान व संतोष आए।
माँ सिद्धिदात्री की कृपा से आपको सफलता, बुद्धि और स्थायी सुख मिले। शुभ नवरात्रि!
